company.name: Xanadu
company.shortDescription: Helping businesses unlock the full potential of Canva.
company.description:
Xanadu is a company purpose-built to help enterprises roll out Canva at scale. As a specialised partner focused exclusively on Canva for Business, Xanadu supports businesses with onboarding, enablement, training, and change management to drive deep, lasting adoption across teams.

Operating as a trusted extension of Canva’s enterprise motion, Xanadu combines platform expertise with proven go-to-market and rollout experience to help organisations unlock the full potential of visual communication at work.

Xanadu works closely with Canva’s partner and sales teams to ensure enterprise customers are set up to scale with confidence and consistency.
